source.name: Game Mechanics
source.instructions: Describe your game mechanics: How does the player move? What does the player collect, avoid, or interact with? What ends the game? If Medium/Spicy, what's your unique or new mechanic?
source.command: python3 .guides/secure/freetext.py --use-llm --question 'Describe your game mechanics: how the player moves, what they interact with, what ends the game, and any unique mechanics.'
